description: Rothco Kid's M-65 Field Jacket is the ideal outerwear for your child's outdoor adventures. Crafted from a durable 55% cotton / 45% polyester twill outer shell, this field jacket is designed to withstand the elements and provide long-lasting wear. The water-repellent finish ensures your child stays dry in wet conditions, while the built-in quilted liner made of 100% polyester adds an extra layer of warmth and comfort. The outdoor jacket features a hook & loop neck closure and a concealed hood with a brass zipper closure for added protection against wind and rain. The hood matches the color of the outer shell and is detachable for versatile wear. With button-down epaulettes, large chest pockets with snap closures, and large waist cargo pockets with snap seals, this all-weather jacket offers ample storage space for all your child's essentials. Hook & loop wrist cuffs allow for attachment to gloves, ensuring a secure fit. The right-hand zipper pull and bottom drawstring provide additional functionality and comfort, while snap-up storm flaps offer extra protection from the elements. Rothco Kid's M-65 Field Jacket is a classic and practical choice for any young adventurer.
